harness_notes: Same harness as shift-session: each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]`, the seed ends with a 'Live state' section standing in for the repos, trackers, memory directory and session tools, and every command or tool call is logged as a fenced ```json {"action", "args"} block. Besides Skill, these runs may also call Read, because the skill reads shift-session's SKILL.md from the plugin; the baseline has no plugin and nothing to read. `prompt` runs with the plugin loaded, `baseline_prompt` without it. Evals 6 and 7 test the resume: eval 6's seed ends with the resume hook's note, as a real next prompt in an on-hold session would, and eval 7's prompt is a pasted handoff, so both configurations get the same prompt there.
